children: August Retail Sales: +1.2% M/M to $773.9B vs. +0.7% consensus and -0.5% in July (revised from -0.6%), according to data released by the U.S. Census Bureau on Wednesday.
Core retail sales, excluding motor vehicles and parts, +1.4% vs. +0.5% consensus and -0.2% prior (revised from -0.3%).
Retail sales, excluding gas and autos: +1.2% vs. +0.4% consensus and -0.3% prior (revised from -0.2%).

title: Retail sales rebound in August, beating consensus
